title.suggested: Tom Allen Arrives in Cincinnati to Train for McCoole

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reprinted a Cincinnati Commercial report that Tom Allen had arrived in Cincinnati to train at the Buckeye House under Coyne and Earl for his November 10 fight with Mike McCoole.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, October 14, 1869

facts.fact: Allen arrived in Cincinnati to stay until his fight with McCoole, training at the old Buckeye House under Jim Coyne and Earl, where he trained the previous spring
Allen's second fight with Mike McCoole was set for November 10, 1869, within fifty miles of Cincinnati
Allen was to give an exhibition in Cincinnati, probably at Mozart Hall

notes: Current title and summary are wrong (no Gallagher fight here; summary is garbled OCR). The Commercial of the 12th says he arrived 'yesterday', so October 11
